name: Download Clients
description: Sends releases to the download clients Radarr and Sonarr support, such as qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, rTorrent, SABnzbd and NZBGet, and follows their downloads.
author: Mavio
configSchema: {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"clients":{"type":"array","description":"The configured download clients","items":{"type":"object","required":["id","definition"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"name":{"type":"string"},"definition":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"The ID of the client's definition"},"enabled":{"type":"boolean","default":true},"priority":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":50,"default":1,"description":"Clients of a protocol are used by priority, lower first, and in turn among equals"},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"uniqueItems":true,"description":"The client takes the media of these tags; a client without tags takes the media no tagged client does"},"remove_completed_downloads":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"Remove imported downloads from the client once they are done seeding"},"remove_failed_downloads":{"type":"boolean","default":true,"description":"Remove failed downloads from the client"},"settings":{"type":"object","description":"The settings the definition takes"}},"additionalProperties":false}},"history_limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"default":60,"description":"How many downloads of the clients' histories are read; 60 when 0"}},"additionalProperties":false}
